title: Práctica Docente Histórica Digital (PDHD-U1): pre-validation corpus and provenance package for Mexican teaching-practice history
description: Práctica Docente Histórica Digital (PDHD-U1) is a provenance-first historical research dataset for reproducible study of teaching-practice history in Mexico. This pre-validation release contains a controlled pilot of 24 documents and 96 fixed documentary fragments, together with source and document metadata, rights policies, structured retrieval provenance, versioned substitutions, schemas, a deterministic 12-item calibration cohort and an 84-item reliability reserve. All 96 fragments are localized and frozen, while human semantic coding and gold labels remain deliberately at zero. The release supports auditing, reuse and replication of corpus-construction methods but does not constitute a validated benchmark or a representative sample of Mexican teaching practice.
rights_note: CC BY 4.0 applies only to original PDHD-derived data and metadata where PDHD has legal capacity to license them. Third-party historical documents, page images, facsimiles, OCR, transcriptions and third-party metadata remain subject to their own rights statements. See RIGHTS.md, DATA_LICENSE.md and data/catalog/rights_registry.csv.
